tei:div.tei:p: (359)rdo rje phur pa rgyud lugs kyi drag po'i sbyin sreg rta gdong rngams zhugs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ (360)

shrī badz+ra ku mā ra na ma/ da ni bsad pa'i las kyi mtha' bsdud drag po'i sbyin bsreg gi rim pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ rdo rje bkod pa las/ de nas dkyil 'khor bya ba ni/ gru gsum cha ni mnyam pa la/ dbus su gru gsum khru gang bsko/ kha khyer gsum rtse sor bzhi'i tshad/ mu khyud zlum so sor gsum pa/ gru chad bzhi yis rnam par brgyan/ phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ bar khyams dang ni sgo bzhir bcas/ phyi rim mthing nag me ris bskor/ zhes dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i dag du byas nas (361) bshad cing*/ de la ni dbus kyi char bu shing khru gang gzur gsum du brtsegs nas de'i nang du thal chen dang*/ ro sol dang*/ ma hi'i rus pa dang*/ shi skra sogs 'jug par bshad pa yin no/ spyir sbyin bsreg la sgo rdzogs spang pa'i mtha' ma mchis kyang bsreg rkyang dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel ba'i rigs la rdo rje khros pa las/ gnag cing rtsub pa drag po'i thab/ rim pa gsum ldan zhal gyi dbyibs/ zhes pa dang mthun par phur pa'i rgyud sde gzhan pa nas/ sa gzhi kha dog nag po la/ gru gsum khru gang thur du bskor/ (362) zhes dang*/ de la kha khyer gsum dang ldan/ zabs dang rgyar yang mnyam pa la/ hom khung sor ni bzhi par bya/ dang po la'ang thod pa gsum/ bar pa dag la mtshon cha lnga/ mtha' mar rtsa dmar dag gis bskor/ zhes pas/ mngon spyod las la 'bras bu 'byin pa'i sar/ sa yi cho ga legs par bya zhing*/ gzhi bdag la gtor ma bsngos te bden tshig gis bkrol/ rgyal pa'i chad pa dang g.yul gyis bum pa'i sa la stegs bu gru gsum pa'i rtse mo ltor ba ltas pa byas la khrag dang a mṛ tas chag chag gdab pa'i dbus rgyar khru gang*/ zabs zu khru gang ngam phyed cha thur du brus pa la/ ro sol dang/ thal chen dang*/ dug khrag sna tshogs pas byug kha khyer sor bzhi phyir bskyed pa ma thod pa tshar gsum bri/ de nas

(363) sor bzhi gyen du slong ba la khrag sna tshogs byug de nas steng gi cha sor bzhi la mdung dang*/ ral gri dag s+t+wa/ mda' gzhung rnams bri/ de'i phyi lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i rtsang dmar gyis bskor/ thab khung gi dbus su gtso bo yab yum gyi phyag mtshan rdo rje dang thod pa steng 'og tu bri/ gdug pa can gyi shing rnams la/ drag po'i sngags kyis btab nas kyang*/ dbus kyi gru gsum nang du gzhug dmar gtor dang ni zung kar dang*/ lcags phye dang ni rdo phye dang*/ dug gtor la sogs 'gram du bzhag gzugs dang ming rus la sogs pa/ ral gri dum bur gtubs nas ni/ bhan+dha'i nang du bzhag par bya/ skyer tsher dang ni mar khu dang*/ ro shun ras kyi de dag bya/ zhes dang*/ sha khrag (364) rus pa gu gul nas/ dug khrag snying sna tshogs tshad rnams/ bra'o mar khu snye tshe mar/ bong bu rnga mo'i sbangs dang ni/ bya rog 'ug pa'i sha dang bcas/ rnga mo ma he glang gi sha/ chang dang mi sha nya yi sha/ sbal ba lcong mo sbrul gyi sha/ bsregs pas las rnams thams cad 'grub/ ces pa rnams las gang 'grub tshogs par bya/ tsher ma can dang*/ dug shing*/ chu shing*/ sbyang shing la sogs reg bya rtsub la kha dog nag pa'i bud shing zur gsum pas thab kyi nang du zur gsum du gcer/ gong du ngan sngags ne bar bsnyen pa'i ming ro'i sum cha bzhag pa yang thab nang du bcug thod ngan gyi snod du dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ/ dug sna tshogs pa'i me tog sha chen gyi bsur dud/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ (365) tsirta'i dpal bshos/ dug gtor/ sman rag la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsham/ rabs chad kyi thod par gong gi bsreg rdzas rnams dang*/ dum bu drug pa'i snod du liṅga chung ba ming rus can brgya rtsa brgyad/ mchog chen gyi rkang ba'i dgang blugs/ zhing pho mo las byug ba'i sbud pa'am/ ro ras kyang rlung g.yab kyang bsag go gnyis pa ni rgyud las/ yang na dkyil 'khor chen po dang*/ 'brel ba nyid du bya ba yi/

dkyil 'khor rnam gsum rdzogs pa dang*/ gang la dmigs pa'i liṅga la/ dgug gzhug las rnams shes par bya/ gcad dang gtub dang btab pa rnams/ rdo rje sder mo la sogs bya/ de nas me lha spyan yang drang*/ zhes pas/ dang po lha bsnyen gzhung bsrang bzlas pa'i (366) bar du byas la/ tshogs kyi mchod pa bya/ tshogs tha ma'i mal du gdab las ni/ spro na gser skyems gzu dpang btang*/ de nas/ hūm̐/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab/ phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la bab/ shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab/ sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab/ bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab/ khyed kyi dam tshig dus la bab/ mthu rtsal byung ba'i dus la bab/ hūm̐/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ zung zhig chings (367)shig rnam par chings/ gtogs shig srog dang bral bar gyis/ rings par khug la smrar chug cig phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis/ lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlog nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang*/ bsgo ba'i bka' rnams nyan par byos/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ che ge mo ha sa ya ra hri ta na a be sha ya a be sha ya/ shi kri a na yā/ shi kri a na yā/ dz+wa la sa ya dz+wa la sa ya/ ta thā ya ta thā ya/ bhan+dha ya bhan+dha ya sarba big nan baṃ (368)hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshe lung khrus lung gi dgongs pas/ hūm̐/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te/ phung po rdo rjes gtams byas nas/ rnam par shes pa rdo rjer sgom/ ā+oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ s+t+waṃ bha nan/ mo ha gha ya bha ga wan/ shi kri bi kri/ shrī badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐/ bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung gsob pa'i/ rig 'jin bdag cag rnams la ni/ gnod (369)cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ bdud dang bar du gcod pa dang*/ dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tshe ba rnams/

khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ yud tsam gyis ni 'dir khug la/ mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang*/ lus ngag rdul du bshig nas kyang*/ sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mjod/ khro bcu'i bsgral dmigs dang ldan pas/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ pa (370)tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ma tha ma tha hūm̐ phaṭa/ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭa/ pu ru pu ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ mu ru mu ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ ka tang ka te ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ja ye bi ja ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ khro mo bcu yi bsgral dmigs kyis/ hūm̐/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ lha'am gnod sbyin bdud kyang rung*/ nga la bar chad byed pa rnams/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par mjod/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya jaḥ(371)hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pa ra big tan hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ bin+dha bin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gh+ri ha na gh+ri ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba a na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ta thā ya ta thā ya sarba big nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sgo ma bzhi'i/ hūm̐/ bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ khyed kyi dam tshig dus la bab/ sngon chad ji ltar dam bcas pa'i/ mngon spyod phrin las myur du mjod/ bsad gris nya bo gtub cing*/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ baṃ (372)hoḥ ma tha ma tha badz+ra/ dz+wa la dz+wa la badz+ra/ su ru su ru badz+ra/ mu ru mu ru badz+ra/ sarba big nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ thun dbab pa ni/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni/ sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ stobs chen khro bo chen po yis/ klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos/ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs/ nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ka tang ka te/ ja ye ta bi ja ye ta/ a tsi te/ a pa ra tsi te/ ma ra (373)pyai na pra marta ni ye hūm̐ ma ma pā shaṃ ku ru ma taṃ nya ka ra i nan dha ti ma ma karmā shri kraṃ ka te ya sarba big nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

gtun du brdung ba ni/ hūm̐/ rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun/ bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnams/ rdo rje me dbal snying bsregs nas/ lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlog khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du/ rdo rje tho bas brdungs byas nas/ lha yang rung ste brlag par 'gyur/ kha tham kha tham zhes nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod/ (374) zhal du bstab pa ni/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab/ khyed kyi dam tshig dus la bab/ nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang*/ bsgo ba'i bka' ni nyan par byos/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la badz+ra yak+sha kro dha khā hi/ ha ha/ zhes brjod la/ liṅga rnams bsregs rdzas kyi gtso bor bzhag go de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams khros pa'i sems kyi kha lhor phyogs gdong la thal chen phyugs/ stan nag po'i steng mngon spyod kyi chas su zhugs la/ gdol shan nam/ dur khrod las byung ba'i me ro skra dang bcas pa'i dpal 'bar gyis sbar zhing*/ rlung g.yab dang bcas/ jaḥhūm̐ baṃ (375)hoḥ oṃ ag+ne dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod pas raṃ dmar nag gcig tu gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ hūm̐/ gru gsum me yi dkyil 'khor na/ drang srong chen po me yi lha/ chibs su ra skyes kham pa chibs/ sku la me yi slog pa gsol/ zhal gsum phyag drug khro tshul ston/ sku mdog 'dod dgur bsgyur mjad cing*/ phyag drug mjes pa'i mtshon cha ni/ gun+dhe me thab bgrang phreng dang*/ spyi blubs skyabs sbyin phur bu bsnams/ (376)rdo rje phur pa'i zhabs dang ldan/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku brnyes pa/ gdug byed drag po me yi lha/ gdug pa'i tshogs kun sreg par byed/ gang yin zhing bcu 'tshig par mjod/ hūm̐/ phyogs skyong rgyal po me yi lha/ steng phyogs 'bar ba me yi lha/ phyag g.yas mda' gzhu rang 'gengs bsnams/ g.yon pa me yi phung po 'bar/ dkar ba'i zhal ni gting nas mthing*/ bus shig bus shig me bus shig

rgya mtsho'i gting nas me long la/ (377)ri rab rtse nas me bus shig nyams pa gang yin 'tshig par mjod/ 'byung po gang yin 'tshig par mjod/ hūm̐/ phyogs skyong rgyal po mi yi lha/ shar phyogs 'bar ba me yi lha/ phyag g.yas 'khor lo dkar po bsnams/ g.yon pa me yi phung po bsnams/ sku mdog dkar po shin tu gsal/ bus shig bus shig me bus shig rgya mtsho'i gting nas me long la/ ri rab rtse nas me bus shig nyams pa gang yin 'tshig par (378)mjod/ 'byung po gang yin 'tshig par mjod/ hūm̐/ phyogs skyong rgyal po me yi lha/ shar lho 'bar ba me yi lha/ phyag g.yas dgra s+t+wa rab tu 'debs/ g.yon pa me yi phung po bsnams/ dmar sngo sku mdog rab tu gsal/ bus shig bus shig me bus shig rgya mtsho'i gting nas me long la/ ri rab rtse nas me bus shig nyams pa gang yin 'tshig par mjod/ 'byung po gang yin 'tshig par mjod/ hūm̐/ phyogs skyong rgyal po me yi lha/ lho phyogs 'bar ba me yi lha/ (379)phyag g.yas dgra s+t+wa rab tu 'debs/ g.yon pa me yi phung po bsnams/ sku mdog sngon po shin tu gsal/ bus shig bus shig me bus shig rgya mtsho'i gting nas me long la/ ri rab rtse nas me bus shig nyams pa gangayin 'tshig par mjod/ 'byung po gang yin 'tshig par mjod/ hūm̐/ phyogs skyong rgyal po me yi lha/ lho nub 'bar ba me yi lha/ phyag g.yas ral gri rab tu 'debs/ g.yon pa me yi phug po bsnams/ ljang sngon sku mdog rab tu (380)gsal/ bus shig bus shig me bus shig rgya mtsho'i gting nas me long la/ ri rab rtse nas me bus shig nyams pa gang yin 'tshig par mjod/ 'byung po gang yin 'tshig par mjod/ hūm̐/ phyogs skyong rgyal po me yi lha/ nub phyogs 'bar ba me yi lha/ g.yas pas spu gri'i rab tu gcod/ g.yon pa me yi phung po bsnams/ sku mdog dmar po rab tu gsal/ bus shig bus shig me bus shig rgya mtsho'i gting nas me long la/

ri rab rtse nas me bus (381)shig nyams pa gang yin 'tshig par mjod/ 'byung po gang yin 'tshig par mjod/ hūm̐/ phyogs skyong rgyal po me yi lha/ nub byang 'bar ba me yi lha/ phyag g.yas rdul g.yab ba dan bsnams/ g.yon pa me yi phung po bsnams/ sku mdog dmar skya shin tu gsal/ bus shig bus shig me bus shig rgya mtsho'i gting nas me long la/ ri rab rtse nas me bus shig nyams pa gang yin 'tshig par mjod/ 'byung po gang yin 'tshig (382)par mjod/ hūm̐/ phyogs skyong rgyal po me yi lha/ byang phyogs 'bar ba me yi lha/ phyag g.yas rgya gram rab tu 'jin/ g.yon pa me yi phung po bsnams/ ljang nag shin tu gsal ba'i sku/ bus shig bus shig me bus shig rgya mtsho'i gting nas me long la/ ri rab rtse nas me bus shig nyams pa gang yin 'tshigs par mjod/ 'byung po gang yin 'tshig par mjod/ hūm̐/ phyogs skyong rgyal po me yi lha/ byang shar 'bar ba me yi lha/ g.yas pa kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum (383)bsnams/ g.yon pa me yi phung po bsnams/ ljang ser shin tu gsal ba'i sku/ bus shig bus shig me bus shig rgya mtsho'i gting nas me long la/ ri rab rtse nas me bus shig nyams pa gang yin 'tshig par mjod/ 'byung po gang yin 'tshig par mjod/ hūm̐/ phyogs skyong rgyal po me yi lha/ 'og phyogs 'bar ba me yi lha/ phyag g.yas tho ba gtun shing bsnams/ g.yon pa me yi phung po bsnams/ dud kha shin tu gsal ba'i sku/ (384)bus shig bus shig me bus shig rgya mtsho'i gtingak+ṣanas me long la/ ri rab rtse nas me bus shig nyams pa gang yin 'tshig par mjod/ 'byung po gang yin 'tshig par mjod/ zhes pas gsal gdab pa ni/ sbyin bsreg gi las la dbang ba'i don du me lha lhar shes pa'i dgongs ste/ rgyud las/ rnam gsum mchod pa lha la 'bul/ mnyes pa lha yi dngos grub ster/ lha yang drag po me yi chas/ rab tu 'bar ba'i nang na bzhugs/ zhes pa'i don no/

de nas spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ tshur gshegs me yi rgyal po che/ bsreg blugs zhal (385)zas bzhes su gsol/ 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs nas kyang*/ las rnams 'grub par mjad pa dang*/ dngos grub tshul bzhin stsal du gsol/ ag+ne ye rā ja sa ma ya jaḥ zhes dang*/ jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa bstim/ oṃ badz+ra añja la nāṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis zhal bsil dbul/ de nas snum chen gyi gang blugs gsum dbul zhing*/ oṃ ag+ne ye ha bya ka bya/ bha ha ma na ye che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces dang*/ bsreg rdzas rnams/ ag+ne ye dz+wa la raṃ che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces rim pa bzhin du (386) dbul rjes snum chen gyi dgang blugs gsum phul rjes bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras drang srong chen po'i cha byad can/ tshangs pa'i skud pas rab dge ba/ rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis mjes/ zhal gsum phyag drug khro tshul ston/ sku mdog 'dod dgur bsgyur mjad cing*/ phyag drug mjes pa'i mtshon cha ni/ gun+dhe me thab bgrang phreng dang*/ spyi blugs skyabs sbyin phur bu bsnams/ rgyud drug rtsad nas gcod la bstod/ rdo rje phur pa'i zhabs (387)dang ldan/ chu skyes nyi ma'i steng na bzhugs/ dag byed ra yi stan la 'dug bdud rnams 'dul la bdag bstod do/

zhes dang*/ dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mjod/ dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ gdon dang dgra bo brlag par mjod/ ces phrin las bcol/ de nas las kyi dngos grub thob pa'i phyir/ me lha nyid ye shes lha'i pho brang du shes par byas nas mngon spyod kyi las bsgrub pa ni/ las chus bsang zhing*/ me lha'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che'i dbus/ (388)rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chen po 'khyil pa'i klong*/ zhes pa nas/ phyag rgya chen po bdag sbyor cig ces zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ltar dang*/ de nas dgang blugs dbul pa ni/ khrag 'thung gi lha tshogs rnams zhal hom khung lta bur gdangs pa'i nang du gnod byed dgra bgegs kyi ngo bo bsreg blugs kyi rnam par phul bas dgyes pa'i gad mos srid gsum thams cad kyang g.yo zhing 'dar bar gyur/ snum chen gyi gang blugs dbul zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsarba big nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ (389) lan bdun mthar/ sarba sha trūṃ che ge mo a mu ka badz+ra rū pa mā ra ya phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis bskor nas dbul/ de nas bsreg rdzas dbul ba ni/ hūm̐/ 'byung po'i sha ni zan bas zhim/ gti mug mchod pa bla na med/ bla med mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis/ sku yi dngos rgub stsal du gsol/ 'byung po'i khrag ni chang bas zhim/ 'dod chags mchod pa bla na med/ bla med mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis/ gsung gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ (390)'byung po'i brla rkang mar bas zhim/ zhe sdang mchod pa bla na med/ bla med mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis/ thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ dug gsum mchod pa bla na med/ sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ hūm̐/ me yi rgyal po khro bo'i sku/ 'ur 'ur chem chem 'bar ba'i 'od/ khams gsum 'khor ba gzhom pa dang*/ nyon mongs log lta bsreg pa'i phyir/ ye shes me chen 'bar ba yis/

'khor ba'i bag (391)chags bsreg pa dang*/ dngos grub 'tshe ba'i gdug pa can/ khro rgyal 'bar ba'i me la bsreg ces brjod la/ snum chen re dang*/ yam shing*/ liṅga dang*/ bsreg rdzas rnams/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ che ge mo dz+wa la raṃ mā ra ya sarba big nan baṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags re dang bstun rjes/ phrin bcol ni/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang*/ dkon mchog sku dgra dben rtsa 'joms/ chos khrims 'dral dang slob dpon dgra/ rnal 'byor 'joms pa la sogs pa/ bsad dang dbab (392)dang nad ngan gyis/ ji nas brlag par khyod kyis gyis/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du/ rdzas sna bzhi po'i mthar/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ ji nas brlag par khyed kyis gyis/ zhes pa'i bar tshar nyi shu dang*/ de nas khro bcu sprul pa dang bcas pa la 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ steng nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ khro bo chen po hūm̐ mjad dang*/ yum chen rdo rje sgra 'byin ma/ sprul pa phag dang smig bu'i mgo yang sprul dam can tshogs bcas la/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ phrin las (393)drag pos gdul phyir du/ bsreg rdzas mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ garja gar hūm̐ phaṭa/ ag+ne ye che ge mo dz+wa la raṃ/ tshar re dang rdzas sna bzhi spel ba lan lnga 'bul/ dmod bcol ni/ hūm̐/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ lha'am gnod sbyin bdud kyang rung*/ nga la bar chad byed pa rnams/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par gyis/ mngon spyod drag pos myur du sgrol/ hūm̐/ shar nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ khro bo rdo rje rnam (394)par rgyal/ yum chen rdo rje snyems ma dang*/ sprul pa stag dang bya rgod mgo yang sprul dam can tshogs bcas la/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ phrin las drag pos gdul phyir du/ bsreg rdzas mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta bi ja ya hūm̐ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/

ag+ne ye che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gong bzhin rdzas sna bzhi so lan lnga'i mthar/ dmod bcol ni/ hūm̐/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa pa rnams/ lha'am gnod sbyin bdud kyang rung*/ (395)nga la bar chad byed pa rnams/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par gyis/ mngon spyod drag pos myur du sgrol/ hūm̐/ lho nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ khro bo'i rgyal ba gshin rje'i gshed/ yum chen rdo rje dur khrod dang*/ sprul pa dred dang byi la'i mgo yang sprul dam can tshogs bcas la/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ phrin las drag pos gdul phyir du/ bsreg rdzas mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ag+ne (396)ye che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar re dang rdzas sna bzhi spel ba lan lnga 'bul dmod bcol ni/ hūm̐/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ lha'am gnod sbyin bdud kyang rung*/ nga la bar chad byed pa rnams/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par gyis/ mngon spyod drag pos myur du sgrol/ hūm̐/ nub nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ khro bo rgyal po rta mgrin dbang*/ yum chen rdo rje gtum mo dang*/ sprul pa byi la pu shud mgo yang spru dam can tshogs bcas la/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod (397)pa 'bul/ phrin las drag pos gdul phyir du/ bsreg rdzas mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hrīḥhu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ag+ne ye che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar re dang rdzas sna bzhi spel ba lan lnga 'bul/ dmod bcol ni/ hūm̐/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ lha'am gnod sbyin bdud kyang rung*/ nga la bar chad byed pa rnams/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par gyis/ mngon spyod drag pos myur du sgrol/ hūm̐/ byang nas rang byung grub (398)pa'i lha/ khro bo chen po bdud rtsi 'khyil/ yum chen rdo rje rlung 'byin ma/ sprul pa seng ge pha wang mgo

yang sprul dam can tshogs bcas la/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ phrin las drag pos gdul phyir du/ bsreg rdzas mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li hūm̐ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ag+ne ye che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar re dang rdzas sna bzhi spel ba lan lnga 'bul/ dmod bcol ni/ hūm̐/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ (399)lha'am gnod sbyin bdud kyang rung*/ nga la bar chad byed pa rnams/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par gyis/ mngon spyod drag pos myur du sgrol/ hūm̐/ shar lho rang byung grub pa'i lha/ khro bo chen po dbyug sngon can/ yum chen rdo rje sder mo dang*/ sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog mgo yang sprul dam can tshogs bcas la/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ phrin las drag pos gdul phyir du/ bsreg rdzas mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ (400)oṃ badz+ra kro ta nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ag+ne ye che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar re dang rdzas sna bzhi spel ba lan lnga 'bul/ dmod bcom ni/ hūm̐/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ lha'am gnod sbyin bdud kyang rung*/ nga la bar chad byed pa rnams/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par gyis/ mngon spyod drag pos myur du sgrol/ hūm̐/ lho nub rang byung grub pa'i lha/ khro bo chen po mi g.yo mgon/ yum chen rdo rje gtun khung dang*/ sprul pa gzig dang khwa (401)ta'i mgo yang sprul da can tshogs bcas la/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ phrin las drag pos gdul phyir du/ bsreg rdzas mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ār+ya a tsa la hūm̐ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ag+ne ye che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar re dang rdzas sna bzhi spel ba lan lnga 'bul/ dmod bcol ni/ hūm̐/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ lha'am gnod sbyin bdud kyang rung*/ nga la bar chad byed pa rnams/ mthu dang rdzu (402)'phrul med par gyis/

mngon spyod drag pos myur du sgrol/ hūm̐/ nub byang rang byung grub pa'i lha/ khro bo chen po gzhan las rgyal/ yum chen rdo rje mda' snyems ma/ sprul pa spyang ki khra yi mgo yang sprul dam can tshogs bcas la/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchad pa 'bul/ phrin las drag pos gdul phyir du/ bsreg rdzas mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta a pa ra tsi ta hūm̐ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ag+ne ye che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ (403) tshar re dang rdzas bzhi spel ba lan lnga 'bul/ dmod bcol ni/ hūm̐/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ lha'am gnod sbyin bdud kyang rung*/ nga la bar chad byed pa rnams/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par gyis/ mngon spyod drag pos myur du sgrol/ hūm̐/ byang shar rang byung grub pa'i lha/ khro bo khams gsum rnam par rgyal/ yum chen rdo rje gsod ma dang*/ sprul pa dom dang sre mo'i mgo yang sprul dam can tshogs bas la/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i (404)mchod 'bul/ phrin las drag pos gdul phyir du/ bsreg rdzas mchod pa bzhes pa gsol/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lokya bi ja ya hām̐ bin+dha bin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ag+ne ye che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar re dang rdzas sna bzhi spel ba lan lnga 'bul/ dmod bcol ni/ hūm̐/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ lha'am gnod sbyin bdud kyang rung*/ nga la bar chad byed pa rnams/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par gyis/ mngon spyod drag pos yur du sgrol/ hūm̐/ 'og nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ khro bo (405)chen po stobs po che/ yum chen rdo rje bskyod ma dang*/ sprul pa dred dang byi ba'i mgo yang spru dam can tshogs bcas la/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ phrin las drag pos gdul phyir du/ bsreg rdzas mchod pa bzhes su gsaul/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hā ba la hūm̐ s+pha ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ag+ne ye che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar re dam rdzas sna bzhi spel ba lan lnga 'bul/

dmod bcol ni/ hūm̐/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ lha'am (406)gnod sbyin bdud kyang rung*/ nga la bar chad byed pa rnams/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par gyis/ mngon spyod drag pos myur du sgrol/ hūm̐/ shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi nas/ pu shud mgo can la sogs pa/ phrin las shugs kyis grub pa'i lha/ ye shes sgo ma chen mo bzhi/ gru gsum mthing nag dkyil 'khor du/ dam rdzas bdud rtsis mchod pa 'bul/ phrin las drag pos gdul phyir du/ bsreg rdzas mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya bid ya (407)bid ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya na maḥs man+ta hring hring hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya su ru su ru pra su ru ru pra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya mā ra ya mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ag+ne ye che ge mo dz+wa la raṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan bzhi 'bul rjes/ dmod bcol ni/ hūm̐/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ lha'am gnod sbyin bdud kyang rung*/ nga la bar chad byed pa rnams/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par gyis/ mngon spyod drag pos myur du (408)sgrol/ slar yang 'dod pa'i phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir mi lha phyag tshang bar shes nas/ mchod pa ni/ me lha'i rnam pa de nyid logs su phye nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i las mjad par bsam la/ bud shing bsnan/ bsang chu gtor/ snum chen gyi gang blugs gsum dbul ba dang chabs gcig oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ag+ne ye pū tsa khā hi sarba big nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsum gyis me lha gzi mdangs bskyed/ sngar bzhin bsreg rdzas bzhi po/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba big nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ag+ne ye dgra bgegs (409)'byung po mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces tshar shi shu tham pas 'bul rjes/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang*/ dkon mchog sku dgra dben rtsa 'joms/ chos khrims 'dral dang slob dpon dang*/

rnal 'byor 'joms pa la sogs*/ bsad dang nan dang nad ngan gyis/ ji nas brlag par khyed kyis gyis/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ de bzhin du khro bcu so so dang*/ sgo ya bzhi po la lan re phul mthar/ hūm̐/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ lha'am gnod sbyin bdud kyang (410)rung*/ nga la bar chad byed pa rnams/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par gyis/ mngon spyod drag pos myur du sgrol/ dmod bcol bya/ des rū pa brgya rtsa brgyad rdzogs par 'gyur la/ de yang rdzas mang zhing rū pa nyung ba dngak+ṣa/ rū pa mang zhing rdzas nyung ba dang*/ me lhag cing rdzas zad pa dang*/ bsreg rdzas lhag cing me zad pa dang bzhi po ni mngon spyod kyi las 'di'i bar gcod kyi rgyu yin pas/ thams cad mnyam rdzogs yong bar bya'o/ de nas sman gtor rak+ta sogs 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor zhing*/ rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag rtsa brgyad yan lag (411)stong sbyar sman/ rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ sgron ma lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga/ rgyud lnga dug lnga 'joms pa'i bdud/ ye shes lnga po grub pa'i rtsi/ 'chi ba med pa'i dam rdzas che/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca amṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ gtor ma ni/ hūm̐/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang*/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ dpal chen 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ dur khrod (412)mchog gi gnas 'di ru/ zhing chen gsar rnying ti rar bcas/ dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ rgya mtshor bskyil/ mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i tshogs la 'bul/ ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsaul/ ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi/ rak+ta tshar gsum ni phud dang rak+ta bsres la dang po bka' bsgo ba'i phyir phul/ hūm̐/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ zung zhig rgyob cing rnam par chings/ gtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis/ rengs par khug la (413)smrar chug cig

phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis/ nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang*/ bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par byos/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ gnyis pa dam can gnad du dbab pa'i phyir 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ khyod kyi dam tshig dus la bab/ sngon chad ji bzhin bcas pa yis/ mngon spyod phrin las myur du mjod/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ gsum pa mthu dang rdzu 'phrul 'phrog pa'i phyir 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i (414)bgegs/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ lha'am 'on te bdud kyang rung*/ nga la bar chad byed pa rnams/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par shog ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ btun du brdung ba ni/ hūm̐/ rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun/ bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnams/ rdo rje me dbal snying bsreg nas/ lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlogs/ khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du/ rdo rje tho bas brdung byas nas/ lha yang rung ste bsgral bar gyis/ kha thaṃ kha thaṃ kha (415)thaṃ/ khā hi khā hi khā hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ha ha ha/ hūm̐/ snang srid thams cad phur pa'i rang bzhin la/ khams gsum 'khor ba ming yang mi grags kyang*/ rgyal ba'i rdzu 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i phyir/ rdo rje mngon spyod phrin las mjad la bstod/

ces bstod nas bdag nyid gso ba'i phyir bskyed rim gsal la kī la ya brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ gtang rag gi don du tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*/ gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ bgyis pa dang ni bgyid (416)stsal ba/ de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol/ yig rgyas bshags/ rtsa sngags kyis dag blugs gsum phul pa/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mjad/ rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ sangs rgyas yul du gshegs su gsol/ sangs rgyas yul ngu gshegs nas kyang*/ slar yang 'byon par mjad du gsol/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes rnams thugs kar bsdu/ oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā sa me lha la dgang blugs kyi gtang rag dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs kyis gtor ma (417)(418) dbul zhing phrin las bcol/ badz+ra muḥ me lha rang gnas su gshegs/ dug khrag gi chus mi cig car du gzhil la thal ba la zor dang mnan pa'i las bya'o/ phan yon ni rtsa rgyud las/ mngon spyod phrin las nyer bsdu ba/ mthing nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor du/ sbyin bsreg drag po'i las bstan pa/ rdzogs pa'i dus de nyid la yang*/ gnod pa'i dgra bgegs med byas nas/ ye shes lhun grub nyid du'o/ zhes so/ rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud sde rgya mtsho dang*/ sngon gyi phur pa mkhan po rnams kyi gzhung la legs par dpyad nas dpal ldan pad+ma 'od gling du bkod pa'o/// /
